patient_identity.statement: Exact family/individual 1-I; sex and age12F,10M,13F,10F respectively agree with source TableS1 columnsB–E.

genotype.statement: Homozygous NDC1 c.892-21G>A, shared by affected siblings of families1 and2; distinct from family3/4 missense alleles.

segregation.statement: Affected sibling pair homozygous; parents heterozygous, consistent recessive segregation. Family2 healthy sister heterozygous.

phase.statement: Homozygous allele with heterozygous parents; no compound-heterozygous phase ambiguity.

causal_confidence.statement: Recessive NDC1 association supported by two families with this splice allele, RNA exon9 skipping and minigene assays, altered ALADIN localization and NPC density in family1 cells.

evidence.locator: RNA analysis, functional results and Discussion

limitations: Family2 did not supply the same direct cellular assays; relatedness/founder possibility limits independence.
Source biological association does not constitute clinical proof or independent ACMG reclassification. No therapeutic rescue experiment.
Residual normal transcript exists; severity/penetrance and long-term adrenal course unresolved.

phenotype_completeness.statement: Every packet feature compared for1-I; unsupported negatives, terminology overprecision and source contradictions retained explicitly.
limitations: Source Table1 claims100%intellectual disability while2-II is listedno. Table2 minus means neverreported rather than excluded.
Clinical follow-up varies by family and time; absent adrenal insufficiency at assessment is not lifetime exclusion.
